payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison of the performance of CGExpan and LM-Base, indicating that LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to the challenges posed by such text, while CGExpan performs better on well-curated benchmarks.

claims.text: LM-Base outperforms CGExpan for concepts with characteristics of user-generated text due to the challenges in such text.
CGExpan performs better on well-curated benchmarks, while simpler methods like LM-Base excel on user-generated text benchmarks.
Performance drops for SOTA methods like CGExpan are larger on user-generated text compared to simpler baselines like LM-Base.
